name: W Singapore - Sentosa Cove
positioning: A W resort on Sentosa Island's Sentosa Cove marina, with a large outdoor pool with a slide, private plunge-pool suites and a rainforest-style spa
best_for: Families and couples who want a pool-centred island resort near Sentosa's attractions
Wellness-minded travelers interested in AWAY Spa and AiRe recovery therapies

facts.text: The WET Deck pool has a slide.
The design uses organic shapes and greenery that echo Sentosa's flora and fauna.
Rooms have oversized beds, coral-orange sofas and private balconies.
Every room has filtered water taps.
The Penthouse has an outdoor terrace and a private plunge pool with views of the sea and marina.
The hotel is set along the marina waterfront.
The hotel is near Sentosa's beaches and moments from the island's attractions.
The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange scuba diving, sailing trips and island hopping.
SKIRT is an open-fire steakhouse known for Wagyu, dry-aged meats and seafood cooked over a Josper grill and binchotan.

highlights.text: The WET Pool is an outdoor pool with views of the South China Sea, for swimming day or night.
Some suites have private plunge pools with views of the WET pool, the marina and the South China Sea.
AWAY Spa has a rainforest design and facilities including a decompression lounge, infrared therapy, a steam room, a whirlpool and a vitality pool.
AiRe Wellness offers therapies including hyperbaric oxygen, red light therapy and compression recovery.
The lobby has columns that bloom up like mushrooms, and the entrance has glass installations.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes it as a touch less clubby than a standard W, set in an exclusive enclave.
WhataHotel notes the island location means traveling to reach mainland Singapore attractions.
